06Glossary
Niacinamide
A form of vitamin B3 that calms redness, refines the look of pores, and supports the skin barrier — gentle enough for daily use.
Ceramides
Lipids naturally found in skin that hold moisture in and keep irritants out. We add them back into formulas that strip them.
Retinol
A vitamin A derivative that speeds up cell turnover — softens fine lines and evens texture, best introduced slowly.
Hyaluronic Acid
A humectant that can hold up to 1,000x its weight in water — draws moisture into the skin rather than sitting on top of it.
Peptides
Short chains of amino acids that signal skin to produce more collagen — used in our firming and renewal formulas.
Salicylic Acid
An oil-soluble exfoliant that gets inside pores to clear congestion — the active behind our acne-focused formulas.
